entries.title: The Mortuary Assistant
entries.definitive_edition: The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the updated native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unity PC presentation with Definitive Edition content.

primary.why: The Windows PC Definitive Edition route is the best version because the 2024 update adds the expanded Definitive Edition content while PC keeps the best capture/settings flexibility. Public reviews and platform coverage also point to PC as the preferred control/capture route over the console releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Mortuary Assistant on Steam and update it to the Definitive Edition build before starting; the Definitive Edition update adds more haunt events, new bodies, embalming-only mode, bug fixes, and performance improvements.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unity PC release, upgraded to Definitive Edition in 2024.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete updated content plus PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable Switch release, later updated to Definitive Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC Definitive Edition and lower capture/fidelity priority.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release launched alongside the Definitive Edition update.
all_releases.reason: skip: same updated content family, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Definitive Edition update is available on the PC primary route, so no separate platform is needed for completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Definitive Edition is an expanded update rather than a visual remaster; use the current PC build.
